scenarios.title: A starts_with rule gives a prefixed format
scenarios.notes: Rule starts_with feature/. derive returns feature/sdlc/{name}. Pre-flight in pr mode prints slice, state and milestone samples with the prefix. Try prefixes with regex characters, spaces and a trailing slash missing. The state sample holds a timestamp, so check its prefix only.

scenarios.title: An ends_with rule gives a suffixed format
scenarios.notes: Rule ends_with -dev. derive returns sdlc/{name}-dev. Pre-flight with no format prints ok true, derived true, the derived format and exit 0. The slice sample is sdlc/S-001-dev. Try a suffix that starts with a dot or a dash.

scenarios.title: A contains rule gives an infix format
scenarios.notes: Rule contains team-a. derive returns sdlc/team-a/{name}. Pre-flight with no format prints ok true, derived true, the derived format and exit 0.

scenarios.title: A derived format that passes every sample is reported clean
scenarios.notes: The output has the derived format and derived true. Every sample has result pass and rule null. No sample has result fail. The pre-flight must write no failing sample.

scenarios.title: Derivation does not apply, so no format is derived
scenarios.notes: Five pre-flight cases keep derived false, ok false and exit 1: format by flag, format by config, two rules, a negated rule, a regex rule. The output format is the given format for flag and config, and sdlc/{name} for the others. derive returns None for a regex rule, for a negated rule of each operator and for two rules. Try an empty rule list and a rule with an unknown operator.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py preflight and name in a scratch repo with a gh shim and read stdout, JSON and exit code
Return the branch-name rules for each case through the gh shim
Call derive through pycall.py with generated rule lists

riskReason: The slice adds characterization tests only and changes no product code in a small pure function plus one command.
notes: Test-only slice. Security and limits profiles are not tagged because the slice states no number and adds no new input path. The cap for low risk is 2 profiles: cli covers all five scenarios and contract covers four.
